summary: Smoke/regression on freshly cloned Berkah Ayam Mili app. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed (auth for 4 roles + wrong password, 12 key GET endpoints incl. dashboard/products/sales/stock-movements/reports/settings/storage/whatsapp diagnostics, POS cash sale flow, profit-loss PDF returns application/pdf with %PDF header, RBAC for kasir on /auth/users, /settings PUT, /daily-closing, and /upload rejected gracefully as 4xx since R2 not configured). Frontend: root redirects to /login, owner login → /dashboard renders 'Omzet Hari Ini', 'Ayam Terjual', 'Laba Kotor', 'Margin' KPI cards, 7-day sales chart, and ONLINE/LIVE badge is visible in header. All 13 sidebar pages (Kasir, Stok, Produksi, Pelanggan, Supplier, Keuangan, Target, Tutup Buku, Audit, Pengguna, Pengaturan, Laporan, Riwayat) load without blank screens. POS: clicking product adds to cart (Rp total shown). Kasir role: 'Tutup Buku', 'Pengguna', 'Pengaturan', 'Audit Log' menus hidden. App is fully functional after clone.

issues: Menu 'Keuangan' text still appears in DOM for kasir role while 4 other owner-only menus (Tutup Buku, Pengguna, Pengaturan, Audit Log) are correctly hidden. Backend RBAC is enforced so this is UI-visibility only; verify if intended.

action_items: (Optional) Confirm whether kasir should see the 'Keuangan' menu; if not, hide it in the sidebar like the other owner-only menus.
critical_code_review_comments: No /api/whatsapp/status endpoint exists; app exposes /api/whatsapp/settings and /api/whatsapp/diagnostics. Both respond 200 with manual-mode data when Meta env vars are empty — acceptable.
server.py exceeds 3500 lines — recommend splitting into routers per resource (products, sales, dashboard, reports, whatsapp) for maintainability.
test_credentials: owner/berkahayam1, admin/admin123, kasir/kasir123, operator/operator123 — all valid.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing auto-seeded demo products/customers for POS sale test. Created 1 tunai sale via /api/sales during POSSale test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The clone is running end-to-end on Emergent. Backend smoke suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_smoke_clone.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_smoke_clone.py -v`. Note /api/whatsapp/status does not exist; use /api/whatsapp/diagnostics.
